name: Adversarial SQuAD
ability_definition: The ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time without being distracted.

task_realism.reasoning: Finding the correct answer in a document that contains misleading, superficially similar information is a real workplace demand, as in reviewing reports or contracts with near-miss details. However, the distractors are synthetic sentences built to fool models (AddSent), and AddAny variants are ungrammatical. Real workplace distractions are mostly interruptions, competing tasks, noise, and irrelevant but natural content, not one planted decoy sentence.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Each item is a single, static, short Wikipedia paragraph with one distractor appended at the end. There is no duration, no time pressure, no concurrent stimuli, no interruptions, and no stakes. The core condition of the ability, staying focused over a period of time, is entirely absent. The distractor's position and type are also fixed rather than varied the way real work varies them.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It covers only one narrow slice: resisting one lexically overlapping textual decoy in a one-shot task. It does not measure sustained attention, decline in vigilance as the task gets longer, or robustness to changing numbers and kinds of distractors. It also lacks a clean-versus-distracted comparison across tasks of increasing length. The selection step itself noted it is a partial measure.

format_match.reasoning: The inputs are natural-language prose and the outputs are extracted answer spans. This loosely resembles looking up facts in documents. But short single-paragraph contexts with extractive span answers, scored by token-overlap F1, are an academic QA format rather than typical work artifacts or deliverables.

transferability_reasoning: Adversarial SQuAD tests whether a system answers from the true evidence instead of a planted decoy, which maps onto the 'without being distracted' part of Selective Attention. It ignores the 'over a period of time' part entirely. The short, static, synthetic-distractor setup and extractive QA format limit how well scores predict sustained, distraction-resistant focus in real work.

2020.metric: F1 (%) on the AddSent adversarial set
2020.human_reference: General literate adult workforce (crowdworker readers doing reading comprehension with a distractor present). This matches the human evaluation population in Jia & Liang (2017).
